summary: Iteration 34 — Radar auto-discovery A+B+C+D + explain reading toggle. BACKEND: created /app/backend/tests/test_radar_auto.py with 11 tests, 11/11 PASS in 7.3s. Unit (AU._certain, AU.same_company): rejects origin='devinette' and quality='fragile'; accepts annuaire+ok+count>=1+fiable; annuaire-partagé requires named slug/url OR >=2 members; same_company RONA≠Coronado, 'Cascades inc.'≈'Cascades'. API: POST /companies/follow {name:'Cascades'} returns ok; within ~2s GET /notices has a Cascades notice (kind=successfactors, origin=annuaire); /settings shows company with kind=successfactors, auto=true, detected contains 'SuccessFactors'. PUT /settings afterwards creates portal_directory doc {key:'cascades',kind:'successfactors',members:[16-char hash]} with NO user_id/email leakage (hashed only). POST /notices/{id}/undo clears kind, adds 'successfactors' to auto_block, detected='Association automatique annulée…', notice removed from list. POST /notices/{id}/ack hides a dummy notice. PUT /settings with new 'Dollarama' returns auto_detecting=['Dollarama']. PUT /settings that removes kind from a previously associated TEST_BMO (workday) adds 'workday' to auto_block. GET /suggestions returns items with {name,offers,a,best_ips,titles,portal} and excludes followed companies. FRONTEND (Playwright, authenticated member on https://interview-ai-engine.preview.emergentagent.com): radar-auto-notices visible with 8 notices after seeding; each row exposes auto-notice-ok-*, auto-notice-edit-* (opens radar-settings-dialog), auto-notice-undo-*. radar-company-suggestions visible with 2 suggestion-follow-N buttons (Cohere + GitLab). In settings dialog, radar-company-auto-N badges rendered (3 — Agropur, Hydro-Québec, Cascades). Explain panel reading toggle: default reading-light=true, panel bg=rgb(255,255,255) and title color rgb(15,23,42) (WCAG dark text on white in light mode); explain-reading-dark removes reading-light class; explain-reading-big sets inline style zoom=1.15; localStorage.explainReading persists {"light":true,"big":true}; after close+reopen the panel still shows reading-light class and zoom=1.15 (preference persists). Mobile 390px overflow: body.scrollWidth=922 vs innerWidth=390 — horizontal overflow present but origin is the pre-existing 'Portails employeurs' table on the Radar dashboard, NOT the AutoNotices/CompanySuggestions sections (which wrap correctly in the mobile screenshot). Pre-existing responsive design limitation of that table.

issues: Pre-existing: 'Portails employeurs' <table> forces body.scrollWidth=922 at 390px viewport — horizontal scroll on the dashboard. AutoNotices/CompanySuggestions themselves wrap fine; the overflow is from the employer table, not from this iteration's new components.

action_items: (Optional, low priority) Wrap 'Portails employeurs' table in `overflow-x-auto` container or hide low-priority columns at <640px so the Radar dashboard doesn't trigger body horizontal scroll on mobile.

(Optional, cosmetic) 5 duplicate 'Dollarama' notice rows observed in UI from prior test iterations — the notice collection accumulates one row per auto-association cycle. Consider deduping by (user_id, company, kind, status='new') on insert in detect_one() so repeated add/undo loops don't produce ghost notices.
critical_code_review_comments: radar_auto._certain correctly gates on ok + count>=1 + quality='fiable' + origin in CERTAIN; for 'annuaire partagé' the (named OR >=2 members) rule prevents a lone wrong-company member from poisoning the shared directory. Good.
radar_auto.share stores only sha256[:16] of user_id in portal_directory.members and sets upsert on (key, kind, slug). Verified in Mongo: no user_id/email leakage. Good.

radar.put_settings: when a company previously had kind X and the member clears kind in the submitted body, X is appended to auto_block before persisting — correct 'manual removal blocks future auto-association' behaviour. Note: `co['auto_block']` is mutated on the request-side list; since Pydantic validates per-request a mutable default could theoretically share state in Python if the default `[]` were reused — Pydantic v2 creates a new list per model instance, so safe.

radar.follow does NOT call AU.share before launching auto_detect, so the shared directory is only populated on subsequent PUT /settings. This matches the spec ('after PUT /settings…'), but a follow-up PUT is required to seed portal_directory. Consider calling share at the end of detect_one after a successful auto-association so the directory benefits even without a user PUT.

radar_auto.detect_one inserts a new radar_notices doc on every successful association. Over repeated add→undo→add cycles (observed: 5 Dollarama rows in the preview DB), this produces visible duplicates in the UI's notices panel. Consider upserting notices by (user_id, company, kind) or marking old ones as 'seen' when a new one is created.
radar.compare's whole-token same_company logic correctly rejects RONA↔Coronado (iteration 33 verified). Reused here in AU.same_company for suggestions filtering — DRY good.

ScoreExplain.jsx: default reading state is `{light:true, big:false}` and persisted correctly to localStorage.explainReading. The inline style `zoom: 1.15` is a non-standard CSS property (Chromium only); on Firefox this will have no effect. Consider `transform: scale(1.15); transform-origin: top left` with a parent padding bump for cross-browser support.
AutoNotices.jsx polls /notices every 30s via setInterval — reasonable; no visible leak (interval is cleared on unmount via useEffect return).

radar.py Company model: `auto_block: List[str] = []` uses a mutable default — Pydantic v2 handles this safely with per-instance copies, but add `Field(default_factory=list)` to be explicit and future-proof.

radar_discovery.DIRECTORY correctly contains the 16 new verified employers (Agropur, Molson Coors, Cascades, Purolator, Alstom, Kuehne+Nagel, Domtar, Home Depot Canada, Dollarama, Vidéotron, TD, BMO, Thales, Colabor, Cogeco — 15 counted; Airbus+Walmart Canada added earlier). SF/Workday URL helpers are consistent.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (notices, undo, settings auto badges, suggestions, explain-reading light/dark/big toggles + persistence)

seed_data_creation: Followed 'Cascades' (auto-associated to SuccessFactors). Added TEST_BMO temporarily (removed). Cleanup PUT at end removed Cascades. Dollarama entries from earlier iterations remain in settings — intentionally not deleted to avoid wiping prior test context.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To seed a notice fast: POST /companies/follow {name:'Cascades'} — appears within ~2-10s because Cascades is in the static DIRECTORY (SuccessFactors). AU.share is only called from PUT /settings, not from follow(); if a next test needs portal_directory populated, call PUT /settings after the follow. localStorage.explainReading format: {"light":bool,"big":bool}. The explain panel uses CSS class 'reading-light' when light=true and inline style zoom=1.15 when big=true. Mobile overflow at /radar is pre-existing from the 'Portails employeurs' table, not from AutoNotices/CompanySuggestions.
